notes.title: Update Information (June 4th, 2021)
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40522459/c88837d7cba9466bdb55e7385379fa58bdaacaa5.png

Thank you for playing "EARTH DEFENSE FORCE: WORLD BROTHERS".
The following updates have been made.

Update Information：
-Fixed issue of screen not moving smoothly with slow (minor) movements of the mouse.
-Fixed issue which prevented being able to switch Teammates if you made changes to commands from the Options menu before first playing the game.

Thank you for your continued support.
